dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: This place is incredible! Perfect for a bit of cardio, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Around about my third lap, a few Asha started trailing me out of curiosity. But by the tenth, they all had collapsed by the roadside...

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I'm letting them rest — for now, at least. Let's hope we see some progress tomorrow.
